Dehradun sits at the foot of the hills, and its sites come with their own demands — Selaqui's pharma and packaging belt, the Mohabbewala and Patel Nagar industrial areas, plus hill-road and tourism construction that runs through real winters and a heavy monsoon. SAMAN builds porta cabins for that mix. We manufacture IS 2062 MS-frame units at our Greater Noida factory and deliver to Dehradun in 3 to 5 days — and since we're just down the road in Greater Noida, it's one of our shorter runs. A guard cabin at a Selaqui plot or a multi-room office on a hill-road project — call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

SAMAN porta cabins built for the hill-foot climate and delivered to Dehradun in 3–5 days.

Why Buy From SAMAN

Search "porta cabin in Dehradun" and you get a mix of IndiaMART listings and prefab-house sellers, plus a few cabin makers. Most don't say much about how a cabin is built for a hill-foot site — the insulation for a Dehradun winter, the drainage for the monsoon, the anchoring for sloping ground. That's the part that decides whether the cabin works through the year.

We make the porta cabins ourselves, so the person who answers your call knows how they're built. Standard on every SAMAN unit:

  • An IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow-section frame — welded, primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted down so it holds level on a slope.
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panel walls. That insulation cuts both ways in Dehradun — it keeps the cabin warm through a hill winter and cool in summer.
  • A colour-coated GI roof pitched hard for the monsoon, false ceiling beneath.
  • A pre-wired board — MCB, ELCB earthing, points, tube-light provision.

The credentials are real. ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. We started in 2009 and incorporated in 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd — POS is Portable Office Solutions. Over 500 projects delivered, cabins shipped across the country.

Delivery is ₹3,000 standard, transit to Dehradun is 3–5 days, and returns run 7 days with the return freight on you.

Where Porta Cabins Go to Work in Dehradun

Dehradun's mix of industry, institutions, and hill construction shapes the demand:

Selaqui industrial belt / Pharma City (PIN 248011) — Dehradun's main industrial zone out toward Vikasnagar, with pharma, packaging, and engineering units. Gate security cabins and supervisor offices are the steady demand, and the clean-industry setting tends to want a properly finished cabin rather than a rough site-fab one.

Mohabbewala industrial area (PIN 248002) — the manufacturing and logistics belt on the Saharanpur Road side. Security cabins, site stores, and small offices at plot entries.

Patel Nagar industrial estate (PIN 248001) — the older government industrial estate closer to the city. Compact cabins mostly — guard rooms and two-room offices.

And then there's the construction side, which is big in Dehradun: hill-road and highway work, the tourism and hospitality builds around the Dehradun-Mussoorie corridor, education-campus construction, and housing. All of it runs on porta cabins for the site office and the gate.

We dispatch from Greater Noida up the Eastern Peripheral Expressway and the NH-334/Saharanpur route — Dehradun is one of our closer cities, so it's a clean 3–5 day run.

Steep, sealed roofs and insulation built for Dehradun's winters and monsoon.

What You're Getting — Specifications

Built for a hill-foot climate: real winters, a heavy monsoon, sloping sites.

  • Frame: IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow sections, welded, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth — which matters on the sloping ground common around Dehradun.
  • Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panel standard. The insulation does double duty here, holding warmth in winter and keeping summer heat out. Cement board if you want a tougher skin for a long posting.
  • Roof: colour-coated GI, pitched steep for the monsoon, false ceiling beneath, sealed joints. Insulation under the roof matters for the colder months.
  • Floor: anti-skid chequered MS plate, or laminate for an office. On sloping or wet sites we'll recommend a proper raised plinth.
  • Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coated, louvre or sliding windows, fixed glazing on request. All fitted at the factory.
  • Electricals: MCB board pre-wired, 2 to 4 points a room, tube-light points, ELCB earthing.
  • Stock sizes: 8×10, 10×12, 10×20, 10×30, 10×40 ft. Odd size? We'll build it.
  • Layouts: single room, two-room, full multi-room block, attached toilet or pantry on request.

What Dehradun Buyers Use Them For

  • Gate security cabins at Selaqui, Mohabbewala, and Patel Nagar plot entries
  • Supervisor offices and small two-room units at industrial plots
  • Site offices on hill-road and highway construction
  • Site-management cabins on tourism, hospitality, and campus builds
  • Worker rooms and stores on the larger project sites
  • Compact offices for institutional and education-sector construction

Site offices for hill-road, campus, and tourism construction across Dehradun.

Customising It to Your Site

The standard cabin is a starting point. Common changes around Dehradun:

  • Custom dimensions and multi-room layouts
  • Extra roof and wall insulation for the colder hill winter
  • Raised RCC plinth for sloping or wet sites
  • Steeper roof pitch and sealed joints for the monsoon
  • AC provision (wall sleeve cut and a power point) for a summer office
  • Internal partitions, extra doors and windows; plumbing for an attached toilet
  • Two-storey stacking where the load figures allow

Tell us the site and the conditions; we confirm the spec and the price at quote stage.

What a Porta Cabin Costs in Dehradun

No fixed sticker — every cabin is built to order. What moves the number:

  1. Size — an 8×10 single room at the floor, a 10×40 block at the top.
  2. Panel — standard PUF, or cement board for a harder build.
  3. Climate additions — extra insulation for winter, raised plinth for slopes.
  4. Fit-out — bare shell, or fully done with wiring, flooring, paint and AC.
  5. Quantity — five units or more brings the per-unit price down.

For a real figure on your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Getting It to Your Dehradun Site

We load on a flatbed at Greater Noida and run it up the Eastern Peripheral Expressway and the Saharanpur route — the same factory-direct line we run across Delhi NCR, and since Dehradun is close, it's one of our shorter legs. It's the same line that serves cities across north India — see our porta cabin in Gwalior and porta cabin in Lucknow pages. Three to five days in transit. On arrival we set the cabin on your pre-cast RCC plinth — raised where the slope needs it — anchor-bolt it, check the panels, and connect the board. A single room is usable within hours; a multi-room block settles in about a day. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard, with a combined rate for several cabins. One note: for sites up in the hills above Dehradun proper, road access for a flatbed has to be checked first — tell us the exact site and we'll confirm the cabin size the access will take. We don't keep a yard or branch in Dehradun; every cabin is built to your order at the factory and trucked to your site.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Dehradun

Do you deliver porta cabins to Selaqui and Mohabbewala?

Yes — Selaqui, Mohabbewala, Patel Nagar, and construction sites across the Dehradun region. The cabin ships from our Greater Noida factory and takes 3–5 days, since Dehradun is one of our closer cities. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard.

Is the cabin built for a Dehradun winter and monsoon?

Yes. The 50 mm PUF panels insulate against the cold, and for hill-foot sites we can add extra roof and wall insulation for the winter. The GI roof is pitched steep with sealed joints for the heavy monsoon, and the frame is anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth for sloping ground. Tell us the site and we'll match the spec.

What does a porta cabin cost in Dehradun?

It depends on size, panel type, climate additions like extra insulation, fit-out and quantity. We quote against your exact spec rather than publish a fixed price — call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry.

Can you deliver to a hill site above Dehradun?

In most cases yes, but it depends on road access — a flatbed truck needs a road it can physically reach the site on, and very tight or steep hill roads may limit the cabin size we can deliver in one piece. Tell us the exact location and we'll confirm what the access will take before you order.

How long from order to delivery in Dehradun?

Transit is 3–5 days once the cabin's built, since Dehradun is a shorter run for us. Production time depends on the configuration and your place in the queue — standard sizes move faster. We'll confirm a firm timeline at enquiry.

Get a Porta Cabin in Dehradun

Need a porta cabin in Dehradun — for a Selaqui plot, a hill-road project, or a campus or tourism build? Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or leave your requirement in the enquiry form. We'll come back with the right spec for the hill-foot climate, a delivery date, and a firm price. You can also browse our hill-site porta cabin office options for sizes and configurations.
